name: How do you design storage for multiple households?

mainEntity.name: How do you design storage for multiple households?

acceptedAnswer.text: Built-in hall lockers, suite-specific closets, shared mudrooms with individual cubbies, and large attic/crawlspace storage accommodate belongings from multiple generations.
